title: Chromatic Harness Eval Receipt
description: Canonical operational eval-receipt contract (PDR-008 / HERMES-005). One receipt is emitted per completed local-agent mission and is the CI-gate artifact (HERMES-006): a mission lacking a passing receipt fails the gate. Reconciled from hermes_harness_pipeline_scaffold_v1/03_SCHEMAS/eval_receipt.schema.json with the seven required fields kept byte-faithful; adds only the optional, additive fields pr_ref and created_at to support the PR-attachment workflow documented in operations/eval-receipts.md. Distinct from hermes_evaluation_result (the model-quality scorecard) per PDR-008 Decision 3.

pr_ref.description: Optional (additive): the PR number/URL this receipt is attached to. See operations/eval-receipts.md.

created_at.description: Optional (additive): ISO-8601 timestamp the receipt was emitted.
